name: blueprint/blocked-page-recovery
description: The escalation ladder when a fetch fails: 403/429, WAF, paywall, bot wall. Documented as a decision chain over the guardedFetch learnings this repo already earned the hard way.
ingredients: browser tools as the final escalation
recipe: fetch fails -> record the failure (code + url + at) -> ladder: retry with backoff (429) -> browser User-Agent (Reddit JSON 403 -> RSS works) -> Accept header fixes -> different endpoint of the same source (HN HTML -> Algolia JSON) -> archive/mirror -> browser tools -> give up with the receipt
result_kind: one attempt receipt per rung + the recovered text or a clean give-up
pitfalls: retry BEFORE switching source - a 429 is not a 403
record each rung: the receipt is what makes the ladder auditable
probe selector/markup before parsing - HN dropped titlelink
Cloudflare egress can 503 a feed that a browser UA does not (Google News RSS)
paywalls are not a technical wall - summarize what is visible, do not fabricate
